name: sticker-press
title: Sticker Press
description: Playful sticker-shop brutalism. Cream paper, black ink borders, zero-blur hard shadows, signal-yellow accent with black text always, Archivo Black ALL-CAPS display over Space Grotesk body and Space Mono labels, press-into-shadow motion, starburst seals and sticker badges, radius 0.
author: uiforagents
notes: One-shot PASS 2026-10-12, event announcement page. Zero-blur hard-shadow ladder (2px chips / 4px default / 8px hero overlay), one bottom-right direction per page, shadow color = the border token; press-into-shadow motion (rest 4px, hover 2px, active none). Radius 0 everywhere; no rounded variants, no blur, no soft shadows. Signal yellow never appears without its ink border (the border is the 3:1 non-text boundary); black text on accent, never accent-on-white. Sticker helpers (coral/sky/green) rationed to one per section. Archivo Black is caps-only and never below 2rem; Space Mono carries all labels, prices, and numbers. One-shot re-run 2026-10-26: PASS - fresh agent given only prompt-pack + theme + overrides built a single product detail page (single-file build), identity-faithful; headless check clean: zero console errors, no document overflow at 1280/390/360.
